title: Marketplace detail page cuts off a wide README with no scrolling, and shows its badges as raw text
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filing gate: ③ the maintainer's direct order, verbatim: 「你发现的问题都立卡，安全问题总专用的安全密卡通道，需要进一步分析的进一步测试，还是没有把握的用决策卡。」 (2026-11-05). Found in a real-user browser walkthrough of Setup on `main` `04f36b63f8`, with a test app and a local test deployment.

**Business reason.** The README is the sales page for an app. Half-cut sentences and raw markup make a production app look unfinished before anyone tries it.

**Reader.** The UI lane dev, for the README block on `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`.

**Duplicates.** Searched `marketplace readme overflow badge` (5 hits). They are a closed checklist card and two seat cards; none has this subject.

## Measured

On HotCRM's detail page at a window width of 883 px:

- Text runs off the right edge. The block measures 835 px wide with 1926 px of content, its overflow is `hidden`, and nothing scrolls. Sentences are cut mid-word, for example `…agents operate it, you ow`.
- The badge row reads as literal text: `![License](LICENSE) ![Manifest](src/sales/index.ts) ![Version](CHANGELOG.md) ![Marketplace](https://cloud.objectos.app)`.

I did not find out which element in the README forces the width, or why the badge images are not rendered.

## Expected

The README fits the page: long lines wrap, and only wide tables or code scroll within themselves. Badges render as images or are left out, never as markup.
